title: Mass-Conserving Saddle Dynamics via Generalized Inner Product: Theory, Algorithms, and Applications
summary: To reveal the effect of the inner product choice, we present a unified formulation of saddle dynamics for the functional F with a mass constraint under different inner products. We establish the equivalence between the index-k saddle points and the linearly stable steady states of the corresponding dynamics. Further, we present the dynamics with discrete H^{-1} and L^2 inner products and numerically verify the convergence orders of both dynamics.
